# ZRCP expected bytes: what ZEsarUX 12.0 answers, and what jnext must answer
# byte for byte (GH #280, zrcp-frontend.md §6.2 / WP-6).
#
# SOURCE. Every reply below was recorded from the real ZEsarUX 12.0 server
# (build 1737051251), launched with --noconfigfile --nowelcomemessage
# --nosplash --disablebetawarning 12.0 --quickexit --enable-remoteprotocol
# --vo null --ao null --machine <the scene line's machine>, one FRESH server
# per scene, by a socket client that writes each command plus LF and keeps the
# exact bytes up to the next prompt (recorded 2026-10-01). The commands are a
# reviewed subset of the design's [T1]..[T5] batches: the exchanges whose
# answer depends on nothing but the session itself (no register values, no ROM
# bytes, no timing), so the same bytes are right on any machine state.
# Exchanges where jnext deliberately differs from ZEsarUX (zrcp-frontend.md
# §10 and §11.3) are not here.
#
# LICENCE. The replies are ZEsarUX's protocol text (ZEsarUX: Copyright (C)
# 2013 Cesar Hernandez Bano, GPL-3.0-or-later), quoted as interface data for
# interoperability tests; jnext is GPL-3.0. No ROM content, no host paths.
#
# CONSUMERS. Both replay every scene against jnext and compare bytes:
#   test/remote/zrcp_adapter_test.cpp  rows ZRCP-FIX-*  (fake transport)
#   test/00regression/zrcp-peer.py     scenario `fixture` (zrcp-func, live)
# zrcp-peer.py also reads its welcome and `run` constants from here.
#
# FORMAT. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#   @scene <name> zesarux-machine=<m>  a new connection; the replies before the
#                                      first > line are the welcome
#   > "<command>"                      sent with a trailing LF
#   < "<bytes>"                        part of the reply; consecutive < lines
#                                      concatenate (split after each LF here
#                                      only for reading)
# Strings are double-quoted with four escapes: \n LF, \r CR, \" and \\.
# A reply that does not end with a prompt (`run`, `quit`) is everything that
# arrives before the server goes quiet or closes the connection.
#
# jnext runs every scene as --machine 48k: its 48K mode is the Next core, so
# the tbblue scene, which ZEsarUX only serves on TBBlue, answers the same.

@scene session zesarux-machine=48k
< "Welcome to ZEsarUX remote command protocol (ZRCP)\n"
< "Write help for available commands\n"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> ""
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "noop"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "close-all-menus"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "foo-unknown-command"
< "Unknown command\n"
< "command> "
> "   get-registers   "
< "Unknown command\n"
< "command> "
> "GET-REGISTERS"
< "Unknown command\n"
< "command> "
> "get-debug-settings"
< "1\n"
< "command> "
> "set-debug-settings 0"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "get-debug-settings"
< "0\n"
< "command> "
> "quit"
< "Sayonara baby\n"

@scene memory zesarux-machine=48k
< "Welcome to ZEsarUX remote command protocol (ZRCP)\n"
< "Write help for available commands\n"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "write-memory 32768 65"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "read-memory 32768 1"
< "41\n"
< "command> "
> "write-memory 32768 65 66 67"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "read-memory 32768 3"
< "414243\n"
< "command> "
> "write-memory-raw 32768 0102ff"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "read-memory 32768 3"
< "0102FF\n"
< "command> "
> "set-register XX=1"
< "Error changing register\n"
< "command> "

@scene evaluate zesarux-machine=48k
< "Welcome to ZEsarUX remote command protocol (ZRCP)\n"
< "Write help for available commands\n"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "evaluate 1+2"
< "3\n"
< "command> "
> "evaluate 0x10"
< "Error parsing\n"
< "command> "
> "evaluate 10H"
< "16\n"
< "command> "
> "evaluate 1 AND 1"
< "1\n"
< "command> "
> "evaluate NOT(0)"
< "1\n"
< "command> "
> "evaluate 5 = 5"
< "1\n"
< "command> "
> "evaluate 5 == 5"
< "Error parsing\n"
< "command> "

< "Disabled 2: None\n"
< "Disabled 3: None\n"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 1 PC=0038H"

< "command> "
> "get-membreakpoints"
< "Breakpoints: Off\n"
< "\n"
< "command> "

< "Disabled 3: None\n"

> "set-breakpointaction 1"
< "\n"

< "\n"

< "\n"
< "command> "

< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 4 A<>0 and (HL & 0FFH) = 5"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 5 this is garbage"
< "Error. Error setting breakpoint\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 6 SP>=32768"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 7 PC=0038h"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 9 PC=0 AND ROM=1"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 10 PC=0 AND RAM=5"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 11 PC=0 && A==1"
< "Error. Error setting breakpoint\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 12 PC=0x38"
< "Error. Error setting breakpoint\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 13 PC=38H AND (A<>0)"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 0 PC=0"
< "Error. Index out of range\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 101 PC=0"
< "Error. Index out of range\n"
< "command> "
> "get-breakpoints 1 14"
< "Breakpoints: On\n"
< "Enabled 1: PC=38H\n"
< "Enabled 2: PC=38H AND SEG0=8002H\n"
< "Enabled 3: PC=PEEKW(SP-2) AND SP>=8000H\n"
< "Enabled 4: A<>0 AND (HL&FFH)=5\n"
< "Disabled 5: None\n"
< "Enabled 6: SP>=32768\n"
< "Enabled 7: PC=38H\n"
< "Disabled 8: None\n"
< "Enabled 9: PC=0 AND ROM=1\n"
< "Enabled 10: PC=0 AND RAM=5\n"
< "Disabled 11: None\n"
< "Disabled 12: None\n"
< "Enabled 13: PC=38H AND (A<>0)\n"
< "Disabled 14: None\n"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpointpasscount 2 3"
< "Unknown command\n"
< "command> "
> "disable-breakpoint 1"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "get-breakpoints 1 1"
< "Breakpoints: On\n"
< "Disabled 1: PC=38H\n"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "set-breakpoint 1"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "get-breakpoints 1 1"
< "Breakpoints: On\n"
< "Enabled 1: None\n"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "sb 1 PC=0"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "get-breakpoints 1 1"
< "Breakpoints: On\n"

< "\n"

> "tbblue-get-register 7"

< "command> "
> "tbblue-get-clipwindow layer2"
< "0 255 0 191 \n"

> "tbblue-get-clipwindow ula"

@scene run zesarux-machine=48k
< "Welcome to ZEsarUX remote command protocol (ZRCP)\n"
< "Write help for available commands\n"
< "\n"
< "command> "
> "enter-cpu-step"
< "\n"
< "command@cpu-step> "
> "run"
< "Running until a breakpoint, key press or data sent, menu opening or other event\n"
